title: The Roman Empire
text: The Roman Empire, beginning around 27 BCE under Augustus, grew from the earlier Roman Republic to become one of history's largest empires, spanning Europe, North Africa, and the Middle East at its height. It is known for engineering achievements (roads, aqueducts), law, and language (Latin, which shaped many modern European languages). The Western Roman Empire fell in 476 CE, while the Eastern (Byzantine) Empire continued for another thousand years.
